title: VALUEFLOW: Toward Pluralistic and Steerable Value-based Alignment in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model alignment by predicting the most probable survey responses of different political parties and ideological groups using the OpinionQA dataset.
Evaluating model alignment by predicting the most probable survey responses of different racial groups using the OpinionQA dataset.
Evaluating model alignment by predicting the most probable survey responses of different religious groups using the OpinionQA dataset.
Evaluating model alignment by predicting the most probable survey responses of different sexes using the OpinionQA dataset.
Evaluating model alignment by predicting the most probable survey responses across different income and education levels using the OpinionQA dataset.
Assessing cross-lingual steerability in Arabic, Chinese, and Korean, and evaluating model alignment with non-Western value systems such as Buddhist ethics.
Measuring the instability, prompt variance, and position bias of LLM judges when scoring value intensity, and mitigating it using a relative ranking-based evaluation framework.
